summary: Thunder Compute's Student Program gives students enrolled at a US university $20 of free credit when they sign up with their university email. The credit can be used on A6000 and L40 GPUs. When the credit runs out, normal pay-as-you-go billing applies; the student page does not state a fixed expiration date.
claim_steps: Confirm that you are enrolled at a US university and have a university email address.
Sign up for Thunder Compute with your student email.
Use the automatic $20 credit on supported A6000 or L40 GPUs; normal pay-as-you-go billing applies after it is exhausted.

social_proof.title: Student Program | Thunder Compute
social_proof.text: Sign up with your student email to get $20 of free Thunder Compute credit. Students enrolled at a US university who sign up with their university email qualify for automatic credit.
